'''Virer Hunting Ground''' is an area in [[Vampyrium]] located south-west of [[Sangvesti]]. Twelve [[venator]]s can be found to the west, while a swarm of [[Letvek (Hunter)|letvek]] can be found to the east. Of these twelve venators, one of them is on a hill overlooking the hunting grounds and can only be attacked with ranged.
